name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: A site navigation bar that is invisible at rest, with the logo dead centre, and folds into a floating blurred capsule once the page scrolls under it; a nine-dot button opens a menu drawer.

examples.name: navbar-demo
examples.title: Navbar
examples.description: Logo in the middle, links at the start, Log in and a pill at the end, a menu behind the dots. Scroll the frame: the row folds into a capsule.

examples.name: navbar-scrolled
examples.title: Folded
examples.description: The capsule, pinned with isScrolled: the brand's inverse colour over blurred page, the logo at three quarters, the pill inverted, the dots in their own circle.

examples.name: navbar-minimal
examples.title: Logo and links
examples.description: No actions and no menu: just the brand and the links, still folding on scroll.

props.name: logo
props.description: The brand, centred on wide bars and at the start on narrow ones: a NavbarLogo, or any link with the logo in it.

props.name: actions
props.description: The end group: a quiet NavbarLink such as "Log in" and one NavbarAction pill. Narrow bars hide the link and keep the pill; the drawer shows both again at its top.

props.name: menu
props.description: The drawer's content, NavbarMenuGroups of links. When set, a nine-dot button at the end of the bar opens a Sheet from the end edge.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Names the nine-dot button and titles the drawer.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Names the navigation landmark for screen readers.

props.name: isScrolled
props.description: Pins the folded state. Leave it out and the bar folds itself once the page (or the frame it sits in) has scrolled 64px, and unfolds on the way back.

props.name: children
props.description: NavbarLinks for the start group. Narrow bars hide them, so repeat them in the menu.

props.name: children
props.description: The brand: a wordmark as text, set in the heading font, or an image or SVG with an aria-label on the link.

props.name: isCurrent
props.description: Marks the link to the current page (aria-current="page"); it reads a step heavier.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the pill goes. A React Aria Link, so it works with client routers; pass onPress instead for an action.

props.name: title
props.description: The group's label, e.g. "Explore". Names its list for screen readers.

props.name: size
props.description: lg: the drawer's big links in the heading font. sm: a column of small body-text links.

props.name: isCurrent
props.description: Marks the link to the current page (aria-current="page").

keyboard.action: Moves through the logo, the links, the actions and the menu button, in reading order.
On the menu button, opens the drawer and moves focus into it.
Closes the drawer and returns focus to the menu button.

notes: A header landmark holding one navigation landmark named by navLabel; the logo link names the brand.
The nine-dot button is a real button named by menuLabel, with aria-expanded; the drawer is a dialog with the same name (React Aria DialogTrigger + Sheet).

Hovering a link quietens its neighbours to text.subtle, a colour the engine proves at 4.5:1, never to an opacity. Inside the folded capsule they quieten to a mix that test/navbar.test.tsx proves ≥ 4.5:1 on every tenant and 1,000 fuzz brands, light and dark.
The folded capsule is surface.inverse at the glass opacity plus 8 points, with text.inverse on it: the same test proves ≥ 4.5:1 over black and white backdrops.
Every target is at least 24px tall; every part shows the focus ring.
With reduced motion the capsule switches without moving, the hover dash stays put and only colours fade.

do: Put it first inside the scroller: the page, or the frame it sits in. It takes no room, so start the page's first section with enough top padding to clear it.
Keep the start links to three or four short words, so they clear the centred logo: the bar lays out wide from 640px of its own width, and at that width three fit.
Repeat every link in the menu: narrow bars hide the start group.
dont: Don't put more than one NavbarAction in actions.
Don't give it a background of its own at rest; the bar is meant to be invisible until the page scrolls.
Don't nest it inside a container with overflow hidden and no scroll: it would never fold.

opens: the bar only — the nine-dot button opens the menu drawer from the end edge
